messages:
sam (partnerships): flagging recon delta from reseller: partner invoice shows a single blended line for 'bundle-pro' for July but our ledger needs per-customer, per-sku usage to attribute credits. looks like aggregated payload caused mismatch.

lucia (reseller): sorry, we sent a monthly rollup as one row to reduce payload size. sample line: ```2024-07-31, reseller_account=bigcorp, bundle_pro, total_units=452000, currency=EUR, amount=4520.00``` we also applied a 10% volume discount in the line.

sam (partnerships): key issues: 1) we require customer-level granularity to allocate credits and reconcile entitlements; 2) discounts should not be embedded in raw usage exports (billing applies discounts downstream). why did you include discount in the export?

lucia (reseller): our billing runs before export in our system so we exported post-discount totals. onboarding doc asked for pre-discount usage, looks like we missed that. also we compressed per-customer rows into a single bundle row to save bandwidth.

arpit (eng-billing): that explains the mismatch. pipeline expects usage events to be raw units per account_id+sku per period, no monetary fields. when amount/currency present we treat it as a billing override and we skip detailed attribution, which is why ledger shows large single-line item. we need either per-customer rows or a mapping file linking bundle->constituent accounts.

mira (finance): downstream problem: partner's invoice shows EUR totals; our marketplace contract is USD-settled. partner applied currency conversion and local rounding; our records converted units -> USD at a different rate causing a small rounding variance, but aggregated it becomes material (~$3.2k). finance needs raw units and the pre-discount price used by partner to validate.

lucia (reseller): we can re-run export in two ways: 1) full per-customer, pre-discount raw units CSV (preferred), or 2) bundle breakdown file mapping bundle_id -> [account_id:units]. also we can send the discount and FX factors as metadata if helpful.

sam (partnerships): immediate ask: please resend July raw per-account usage and include a 'pre_discount_unit_count' column. for future: update onboarding to explicitly forbid monetary fields in usage export; discounts and currency conversions must be separate settlement artifacts.

partners-bot: created ticket PART-6234 (reseller bundle export remap) assigned to arpit.

arpit (eng-billing): implementation plan: 1) accept partner re-run and ingest per-account CSV; 2) if partner only provides bundle breakdown, run automated splitter that maps bundle constituents using partner-provided map and emits reconciliation deltas (audit flagged); 3) add a validator in ingestion that rejects uploads with 'amount' or 'currency' unless flagged as settlement files; 4) generate CSV of corrected per-customer usage and a balanced ledger export for finance.

mira (finance): require signed confirmation from reseller on conversion rates used and the discount logic before issuing any credits. also need a per-line audit CSV for accounting.

lucia (reseller): will re-run export tonight with pre-discount per-customer rows and include the FX table used for EUR->USD conversion. timeline: re-export in 8 hours, sample CSV upload in staging, final in 24 hours.

sam (partnerships): thanks. arpit please prepare a dry-run ingest on staging and share the reconciliation CSV here once done. finance: will hold credits until signed confirmation.

arpit (eng-billing): will run dry-run in staging within 6 hours and attach reconciliation CSV to PART-6234. if mapping is ambiguous we'll request the bundle manifest from the partner.

mira (finance): note: if corrected credit > $2k escalate to finance director.

lucia (reseller): appreciate quick turnaround. we'll also add a new export mode 'per_customer_pre_discount' to our integration doc to prevent future issues. :white_check_mark:
